scope: Independent whole-object semantic review of B08 v3 only; no other unit, whole cohort, source activation, producer, runtime/admission, native/Premium, or full BIZQ acceptance.

method.canonicalFingerprint: SHA-256 of canonicalJson whole question object
method.semanticReviewNote: Current question order is not treated as a learner disclosure finding; the separately accepted app option-order correction applies. Length statistics are qualitative signals only, never thresholds.

findings.requirement: Canonical content audit requires truthful case application/boundary and complete Details under docs/07-content-guidelines.md §4.4 and content-audit requirements.
findings.evidence: The repeated boundary/transfer text asserts that an earlier local or external effect committed. i003 explicitly fails before commit with neither mutation visible; i009 explicitly leaves external outcome unknown; i014 fails mapping validation before publication, leaving the prior lesson visible.
findings.risk: Details teaches a false state boundary for the exact cases where the distinction matters, so the learner may apply the commit-point rule incorrectly.
findings.smallestCorrection: Make the boundary and transfer case-specific: atomic pre-commit rollback for i003, preserve unknown and reconcile same issue for i009, and retain the old published revision until mapping validates for i014.

findings.requirement: Canonical content audit requires case-faithful concrete application in Details (§4.4).
findings.evidence: The cooperative lending repayment-validation case calls the error a “retryable allocation error” in feedback.details.scenarioApplication; allocation is absent from the scenario.
findings.risk: A stale domain term makes the explanation describe a different task.
findings.smallestCorrection: Name the retryable repayment-entry validation failure without the allocation label.
